log.msg: Ten-second test at 1280 (baseline, before fixes). STRANGER: this is some kind of index/hub about ancient-technology mysteries and UFO/disclosure claims, sorted by four topics and a confidence rating, but the page never stops scrolling - past the topic cards it turns into a wall of individual claim cards (theories, then a raw newest-first stream) that ran 14,517px/10.4 screens deep at 3440 with 59pct of the monitor empty beside it. MEANT (page.js description + on-screen question): Four topics in ancient technology, dug in parallel and streamed live, every claim tagged by how sure anyone actually is - matches the stranger read reasonably well; the gap was not WHAT the page is, it was that nothing told a reader they could stop at the topic cards instead of scrolling the whole corpus.

Critique row (rank 1 of the paging critique, quoted verbatim): 41pct wide, 1856px dead, depth 9, scroll 14517/1392 - 368 entries in one 41pct-wide column, 10.4 screens, 59pct of a 3440 monitor empty. Width: realm-alternates already tried width:fill here today and REVERTED it (task.jsonl 17:40) - fill hits 100pct/0px dead alone but squeezes an open topic column to its 288px floor once a child is open beside it (columns fill-vs-open-child bug, matches the coordinators cloudflare/verdict sample). So width stays large, confirmed still the right call, OPEN per the mastermind columns-rule proposal (fill yields to an open child). My fix targets the other half of the finding, DEPTH: measured live at 3440 before my change, the .research-program column was 14413px tall (matches critiques 14517 to within a version); after wrapping board()/stream() in closed <details> it is 877px - a 94pct cut, front now fits inside one 1440px screen with zero data removed (same caps, same N-more links, same per-card renderers).

Primary interaction, ui-test drive.mjs against research-primary-plan.json (1280x900): step click .research-program summary opened the new Theories on the table disclosure, .research-program dh +4425px, screenshot confirms real theory cards rendered - the control does what its label now says. step click .research-topics-row a.research-card-name (Stone) navigated to /imagine/research/stone/, a new column titled Precisely Carved Stone opened with its previews() wall and, critically, no duplicate link list beneath it (the index:true fix verified live, compared before/after screenshots).

Five fixes landed, all in-realm. (1) research/page.js: local ResearchFront class extends Program, overrides head() to add one plain sentence (Pick a topic card below... or open Theories on the table and Latest further down) and overrides board()/stream() to wrap the theories board and the raw stream in closed-by-default <details> - same caps/renderers, just a click instead of a mandatory scroll. Caveat: closed-by-default means a skimmer who misses the triangle never sees a theory or entry card; undo by dropping the details wrap (keep the head() sentence) if the owner wants them open by default. (2) stone/page.js, theories/page.js, disclosure/page.js: added index:true - all three declare children AND call previews() in content(), so core was rendering every child a second time as a plain link list below the card wall (verified live on /imagine/research/stone/ before/after, screenshot). Caveat: none, this is core Page.class.js own documented field for exactly this case. (3)(4)(5) three dead cross-links fixed: disclosure/age-of-disclosure.md and disclosure/grusch-aaro.md linked each other via ./other.md, disclosure/state-of-play.md linked ./odni-2021.md the same way - since each .md is auto-served ONE level up (at disclosure/<name>/, not nested under the linking page), all three resolved to a literal 404 (curl-verified before and after). Fixed to ../<name>/. Caveat: relies on the auto-md-per-file routing convention documented in ext/Research/Program.js found() - if that convention ever changes these three need the same edit again.

Sixth fix: depictions/star-beings.md linked [invented-traditions.md](./invented-traditions.md) - depictions has no per-file routing (no children:, every .md is inlined via md.details on the one index page), so that link left the SPA entirely for a raw text/markdown file (curl-verified 200, wrong content-type, no styling). Tried making it a same-page #invented-traditions anchor first (added .attr(id,...) to the matching md.details call) - Playwright-verified the id and link both resolve, but a fresh navigation OR an in-page click to that hash does NOT open the closed <details> or scroll to it, because the target is built by client JS after the browsers one-time fragment-reveal pass runs (verified: URL hash updates, target.open stays false, scrollY stays 0, even on a cold page.goto with the hash already in the URL). A link that silently does nothing on click is itself a finding, so reverted the id and changed the source text to a plain, honest cross-reference by its ON-SCREEN label instead of a link: See The recency signature, below. depictions/page.js is now byte-identical to HEAD (git diff empty) - the whole fix is the one line in star-beings.md. Caveat: if the framework ever gives SPA pages real post-render hash handling this could become a working link again; until then a plain pointer is more honest than a dead one.

Proposed, not fixed (needs core, outside my fences). /imagine/research/disclosure/ console-logs 9 x 404 on load: <child>/page.js for every one of its 9 declared children (aatip-videos, odni-2021, grusch-aaro, legislation, age-of-disclosure, state-of-play, pursue-disclosure, galileo-project, resolved-cases) - none has a page.js, all are pure auto-served .md siblings. This is core/Page.class.js lazily probing every declared childs page.js before falling back to the .md - pre-existing (confirmed via a scratch check before I touched disclosure/page.js; my only edit there was adding index:true, which does not touch child resolution) and the same pattern already logged as harmless-but-real by realm-alternates today (cms/welcome/page.js). Proposal: Page.class.js child resolution could check directory.json for a page.js before fetching it, the same way Program.found() already avoids probing - one line, ext/, not mine to edit. Layout invariants at 3440 (post-fix): column left edge 480px (never 0), .research-question/.research-theory-why/.research-entry-summary all capped to var(--measure) by Research.css already, no new inline spacing added by any of my edits - all three hold. Verified zero console errors on / stone/ theories/ depictions/ after every fix; disclosure/ carries only the pre-existing 404s above. Final shots: research-1280-after2.png and research-3440-after2.png in the session scratchpad, keeper JPEG (87KB) copied to imagine-review/shots/research.jpg. Skipped the documentation skill pass (no readme.md/doc/ exists anywhere under research/ today, matching every sibling topic dir - adding one now is a bigger surface than this reviews five fixes and was not asked for; noting it here rather than silently skipping).

assign.outcome:
**Rank 1 in the paging critique (41% wide, 1856px dead, depth 9, scroll 14517/1392, 368 entries in one column) is now clear and one screen deep.** The front (`/imagine/research/page.js`) got a local `ResearchFront` subclass of `ext/Research/Program`: one plain sentence in `head()` telling a stranger what to click, and `board()`/`stream()` — the two sections doing nearly all of the growing — wrapped in closed-by-default `<details>`. Same caps, same per-topic "N more" links, same card renderers; only the outer wall is a click now, not a scroll. Measured live: the column's own height at 3440 went from 14,413px to 877px (94% cut), matching the critique's 14,517 before. `width` stays `"large"` — `fill` was tried and reverted earlier today (`realm-alternates/task.jsonl`): it hits 100%/0px dead alone but squeezes an open topic column to its 288px floor, still open pending the mastermind's columns-rule proposal.

Five more fixes, all verified live: `index: true` on `stone/page.js`, `theories/page.js`, `disclosure/page.js` (each was rendering its `previews()` wall AND a duplicate plain link list underneath — confirmed via before/after screenshot on `/imagine/research/stone/`); three dead cross-links in `disclosure/*.md` that 404'd because each `.md` auto-routes one level up, not nested under the linking page (`../grusch-aaro/` etc., curl-verified 200 after); one dead cross-page link in `depictions/star-beings.md` that left the SPA for a raw `.md` file — tried a same-page `#anchor` first, proved it silently does nothing (the target is built by client JS after the browser's one-time fragment-reveal pass runs), reverted to a plain honest reference by the target's on-screen label instead.

Zero console errors on `/`, `stone/`, `theories/`, `depictions/` after every fix. `disclosure/` carries 9 pre-existing `<child>/page.js` 404s (core's own lazy-load probe for md-only children, unchanged by my one-line edit there, same pattern already logged as harmless by `realm-alternates` on a different realm today) — a one-line core fix, proposed in the log, not mine to make.

**Left open, with reason:** the front's width-percent-used stays unchanged (the `fill` trade-off was already measured and reverted earlier today, pending an owner decision on the columns-rule proposal) — this task fixed the other half of the same finding, the 10-screen depth, which is now gone.
